name: fr-urban-rules-service
description: Companion service of com.archisimple.fr-urban-rules: reads a plot's règlement from the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme and finds its zone's chapter (Sprint 002.5a), reads it with a model on request (002.5b), watches the documents it holds for a new version (002.10) and proxies Géorisques v2 with the deployment's token (002.10).
